title: Customer case study
description: Tell how a customer solved a problem with the product, with measured results and the customer's written approval to publish.

inputs.label: Customer organisation and the contact who agreed to take part
Results measured before and after, with their period
The customer's written approval of the text, the quote and the use of their name and logo

tool_actions.description: Sending the draft to the customer for approval.
Publishing the case study on the website or in sales material.

sections.title: Customer and context
sections.prompt: Who the customer is, their size and sector, and the team that uses the product.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.prompt: The problem before the product, in the customer's words.

sections.title: Alternatives considered
sections.prompt: What the customer used or evaluated before, from their account or the market dossier.

sections.title: Solution
sections.prompt: How the customer uses the product, including what they had to change.

sections.title: Results
sections.prompt: Each result with its baseline, its period and how it was measured.

sections.title: Customer quote
sections.prompt: A quote from the contact who approved it.

checks.verification: The customer approved the final text, the quote and the use of their name and logo in writing.
Each figure matches data the customer or the team can show, with its period.
Only people who agreed are named, and no other personal data appears.
